scope.reason: This probes route discovery and CommonJS interprocedural linking before SSRF-specific semantics, which SPARDA does not currently claim.

label.criterion: The external application is intentionally vulnerable and its handler passes a request-composed URL to an HTTP client without an allow-list.
label.why: displayResearch concatenates req.query.url and req.query.symbol, then calls needle.get on that attacker-controlled URL.

missCause: the CommonJS route and handler chain are linked; SSRF data flow is a separately declared future capability
